comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Outsourced services provider paid a revenue share by partner universities; it doesn't operate schools or enroll students itself.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Operates for-profit nursing and allied health colleges funded by tuition and student aid, like Rasmussen, though regional and smaller.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: For-profit accredited online universities serving adult students on tuition and Title IV aid, with a health sciences school.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Online and campus degree programs for working adults, with military benefits and employer tuition, funded by tuition and Title IV.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Mainly K-12 virtual schools funded per pupil by public school systems, a different customer and funding model.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Campus-based automotive and skilled trades vocational training, a different field and student base, though also tuition and Title IV funded.
